svg.title: What a guest account can reach — SoftTrack web design mockup (#317)
svg.desc: A guest is a role on one membership, so outside that team a client’s account is an ordinary one: it can create teams, claim expenses and read the whole directory. Marked as outside the organisation, the account loses those routes, the sidebar stops offering them, and member lists show names without addresses.
svg.text: What a guest account can reach
· an outside account gets the team it was invited to, and nothing beside it
What an outside account is offered
signed in as Carlos, a client, guest of Engineering

svg.text: Done when an account can be marked as outside the organisation (#243), such an account cannot create a team or submit a claim, it sees no directory, departments or workload,
the filtering happens in the query, and a sweep test fails on a new route that forgot the check. Until then, users.md says plainly what a guest account can reach.

without knowing. The account type is #243.
A page and not a redirect, as with finance: whoever follows the
link should learn why there is nothing here.
Names and roles. No email addresses, and no invitation form.
